# Shoppizzy
> Shoppizzy is a direct-fulfillment e-commerce store selling grocery essentials, household goods, feminine care, baby care, and everyday products. All products are shipped directly by Shoppizzy via UPS with tracked delivery and a 30-day return policy.

Shoppizzy operates two direct-fulfillment catalogs:
- **Square catalog** (~420 items): curated products across multiple categories including beverages, baby care, pet care, snacks, electronics, and more.
- **GrowceryWorld catalog** (~16,000+ items): grocery and household essentials including canned foods, beverages, condiments, breakfast items, pasta, rice, baking supplies, and more.

## API Endpoints
- **Product search**: `GET https://shoppizzy.com/api/products?q={query}` — returns JSON with title, price, availability, image URL, brand, category, and source for each result. Supports `limit`, `page`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `category` parameters.
- **Category search**: `GET https://shoppizzy.com/api/products/category?keywords={comma-separated-keywords}&limit={n}` — returns products matching any of the provided keywords across both catalogs.
- **Product count**: `GET https://shoppizzy.com/api/product-count` — returns total number of active products.
- **Google Shopping feed**: `GET https://shoppizzy.com/api/google-feed` — machine-readable RSS/XML feed of direct inventory with price, availability, image, shipping, and Google product category.
- **Single product**: `GET https://shoppizzy.com/api/products/{id}` — returns full product details for a specific product ID.

## Categories
Baby Care, Baking, Beverages, Books, Breakfast, Canned Foods, Canning Supplies, Cleaning, Condiments, Cookies & Crackers, Electronics, Feminine Care, General Merchandise, Grocery & Pantry, Health & Beauty, Home & Garden, Household, Laundry Care, Paper Goods, Pasta, Pet Care, Rice, Snacks, Spreads & Toppings, Toys

## Product Types
- **Direct products** (source: "square" or "seller"): fulfilled and shipped by Shoppizzy via UPS Ground. Eligible for Shoppizzy's 30-day return policy. Prices and availability update nightly at 11:00 PM UTC via automated sync.
- All products on Shoppizzy are direct-fulfillment — there are no affiliate or third-party redirect products in search results.

## Checkout
- Square hosted checkout and PayPal (including Venmo) are supported.
- Shipping calculated in real time via UPS rates based on destination ZIP code.
- Membership available at $20/yr — includes a free item with every order and access to member coupons.

## Policies
- Returns & Refunds: https://shoppizzy.com/returns.html
- Privacy Policy: https://shoppizzy.com/privacy-policy.html
- Terms of Service: https://shoppizzy.com/terms-of-service.html
- Affiliate Disclosure: https://shoppizzy.com/affiliate-disclosure.html

## Notes for Agents
- All search results are direct-fulfillment products — no affiliate redirects.
- Prices and stock update nightly at 11:00 PM UTC. For real-time availability, query the product search API directly.
- Product search API returns `stock_quantity` for Square items. GrowceryWorld items do not track live stock counts.
- For broad catalog discovery, use the category search endpoint with relevant keywords rather than crawling individual product pages.
- JSON-LD Product schema is present on all individual product pages at https://shoppizzy.com/product.html?id={product_id}
- Sitemap: https://shoppizzy.com/sitemap.xml
